He performed the voice of Rumpelstiltskin in Shrek Forever After (2010), [ 5 ] as well as various characters in Shrek the Third (2007). He co-directed the film Trolls (2016) and directed

in Shrek Forever After (2010), [ 5 ] as well as various characters in Shrek the Third (2007). He co-directed the film Trolls (2016) and directed its sequels, and voiced various characters in the franchise. With Conrad Vernon , he is co-directing Shrek 5 , set for release in 2027. [ 6 ] Dohrn has worked as writer, director, and storyboard director in season 2 of SpongeBob SquarePants , and he also worked on 2 episodes from season 3 . [ 7 ] In 2020, Dohrn signed a deal with DreamWorks Animation .
